command: for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do sleep 4; WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"] if d else "")'); test -n "$WS" || break; OUT=$(WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`JSON.stringify({text:document.body.innerText,buttons:[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean)})`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){process.stdout.write(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' 2>/dev/null || true); printf 'BLE_POLL_%s=%s\n' "$i" "$(printf '%s' "$OUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; s=sys.stdin.read(); print(" | ".join(json.loads(s)["text"].splitlines()[-20:]) if s else "NO_DOM")')"; printf '%s' "$OUT" >/tmp/lcl_ble_last.json; done; true
